notes:
Arm B of S11 stream2-whatis: a what-is inventory of every reporting surface, check, unrecognized-input reinterpretation, and duplicated job in the repository, written to the S11 untracked arm directory for stream2-whatis (file arm-b-whatis.md) — deliberately outside the tracked tree per the brief, so no citation in this findings file points at it. Every mechanism in the arm document carries a file:line citation resolved at HEAD faa5628-dirty on 2026-08-24.

THE SIX COUNTS this sprint's baseline is built on, each with its method:

(1) REPORTING SURFACES FOUND: 68. Method: full enumeration — all 38 bin/managent verbs extracted from the dispatch chain in src/managent/main.zig (1435-1523), 3 argus modes, 10 dashboard/fleet surfaces, 6 engine/oracle tools, 8 runner/delegation surfaces, 4 suite/acceptance gates. The §1 tables of the arm doc are the audit trail; each surface's no-data behavior is stated with the deciding line.

(2) SURFACES EMITTING A VALUE WHERE THE HONEST ANSWER IS 'CANNOT DETERMINE': 6 of 68. Each verified at its deciding line: (a) managent why prints '-- no tasks reference this claim --' identically for an unknown id and a real claim with zero tasks (src/managent/main.zig:7834; demonstrated live with a nonexistent claim id); (b) managent audit reads every citable surface with readFileAlloc catch "" so an unreadable register silently becomes an empty corpus after which all substring probes miss (main.zig:9521-9546); (c) argus doctor's heartbeat check falls through to 'Conservatively call CLEAN since no marker fired' when liveness output cannot be parsed (bin/argus:893-897); (d) argus orphan-gate silently skips its findings-vs-baseline comparison when the baseline field does not parse (bin/argus:533); (e) argus checklist's claimlint slug always reports 'at or below floor' because ALL FOUR of its parse regexes match nothing in current claimlint output (verified empirically on 2026-08-24 by running the regexes against live output — see count 3); (f) the runner swallows heartbeat write failures with except OSError: pass (tools/runner:701-704), so a lost beat is invisible at the emission site even though downstream liveness honestly renders UNKNOWN.

(3) CHECKS THAT CANNOT FAIL UNDER ANY INPUT: 4, plus 8 more that no gate runs. The 4: two retired stubs wired into zig build test that echo and exit 0 unconditionally (regression-runner-host-guard.sh:33-36 at build.zig:333-335; regression-subagent-resident-gate.sh:33-36 at build.zig:352-354); orcha-acceptance AC3 which prints PASS with no measurement behind it (tools/orcha-acceptance.sh:89-90); and argus checklist slug claimlint-green, which is regex-dead against current claimlint wording — C1a orphans:, C2 total:, C6 cite-tag mismatches: and 'calibration: PASS' match none of claimlint's actual lines ('C1a ORPHANED orphans:', 'C2 DEAD-LINKS total:', 'C6 MISCITED cite-tag mismatches:', 'calibration                   PASS'; regexes bin/argus:385-391 vs src/claimlint.zig:3400-3430), so violations is always empty and the slug always reads green. Additionally the whole checklist mode is dead: its default registry file was folded away by T557 and the mode refuses rc=1 (verified live). The 8: regression scripts reachable by no gate — arbiter, managent-done-git, managent-memory-safety, process-ownership, race-collect, request-accounting, scratch-repo, task-identity are referenced by no addSystemCommand in build.zig and invoked by no other script (78 of 86 are wired; method: literal-string diff plus reverse grep). Note regression-arbiter.sh is T821's REPLACEMENT coverage for the retired host-guard stub and is itself unwired. Nothing runs any of it on a schedule (daily unattended runner disabled 2026-08-24).

(4) PLACES REINTERPRETING UNRECOGNIZED INPUT AS VALID: 6 mechanisms. (a) managent ignores every unknown flag on all 38 verbs — positive-match-only lookup (hasFlag/getFlagValue main.zig:3479-3492), no rejection anywhere; demonstrated end-to-end with the brief's example: done T860 --verdict pass silently defaults the close to pass (main.zig:4650,4688-4696), stopped only by the separate impression gate; (b) non-numeric --stale-min or LIVENESS_STALE_MIN silently reverts to the 5.0-minute default (main.zig:11421-11430, same in cmdReap from 11539); (c) bin/subagent parse_argv accepts ANY --word into its flags dict without name validation, and the space-separated form of --rss-cap-mb misparses the value into a positional argument (bin/subagent:423-444, tuple at 428); (d) attribution-backfill.py still passes unrecognized model tags through unchanged and falls back to an in-file canonical copy when the binary is absent (lines 77-118), where post-T801 model_tags.py raises UnknownModelTag instead (165-177); (e) argus doctor accepts two retired liveness output formats as valid current readings for backward compat (bin/argus:858-872); (f) argus _extract_command hands an entirely-unrecognized free-text registry field to the shell as a command (bin/argus:107-123). Counter-examples that DO refuse are recorded: unknown managent commands, GTP unknown commands (? reply, gtp.zig:1845-1846), fleet-keeper unknown args (exit 2), done --status nonsense (enum-validated).

(5) JOBS WITH MORE THAN ONE IMPLEMENTATION: 7. Model-tag canonicalization x4 (managent authoritative; model_tags.py reader; attribution-backfill.py independent copy; prose registry doc); the claimlint floor x2 divergent copies (enforced floor json has C1a=0/C2=0/C3=42/C6=0 while argus carried CLAIMLINT_FLOOR {C1a:10,C2:12,C6:0}, bin/argus:365); per-task token readings x3 (runner trailer, heartbeat fields, tokens.jsonl ledger — named together by tools/runner:671-676); process liveness x3 (liveness heartbeats, reap run-records+ps, watch-fleet transcript-age FRESH column); progress narrative x3+ (orient, resume, per-sprint STATUS.md files, each self-describing as the surface); artifact persistence x2 generations (artifact.zig wzo ADR-0011 vs artifact2.zig wzo2); suite-redness accounting x2 over different denominators (direct sweep 23-of-86 failing per S11 STATUS.md:82 vs suite-truth manifest 9 failed steps over the 78-wired set, docs/infra/suite-truth.md:188-199).

(6) BLIND SPOTS: stated in §7 of the arm doc — bash commands composed in variables defeat static scan (~20 of 86 scripts read fully, rest structural); Python dynamic imports and env-seam code resolution; build.zig steps counted from literal strings only; deployed binaries may lag cited sources (doctor flagged all seven deployed zig binaries stale when run); mutating managent verbs probed only on my own row; engine-side instruments inventoried at entry-point level only; arm blind by design to stream1 and to arm A.

METHOD NOTE: live verifications performed on 2026-08-24 were managent liveness/why/show/done, full weizigo-claimlint output plus regex replay of argus's parsers against it, argus checklist (refused, registry absent since T557) and doctor dry-run (rc=1, 9 NEEDS ACTION including all seven deployed binaries stale). No code and no test was modified; the only tree change by this task is this findings file.
